title: WEDM Print→CNC One-Shot Spine Closure (Round 4 patch)
philosophy: Round 4 scrutiny (goal-planner) measured 47% stage coverage on the 12-stage Print→CNC pipeline for WEDM. AutoPrintToProgramBridgeEngine has ZERO wire-EDM references — the platform's one-shot entry point cannot currently reach WEDM. This milestone closes the pipeline spine: DWG import, STEP AP242 PMI extraction, AutoBridge WEDM capability manifest, multi-controller post, wire-path collision, program verification, consultAwareness wiring.

engines: AutoPrintToProgramBridgeEngine (EXISTS at camDispatcher.ts:2780-2834, NO wire-EDM branch)
WEDMPrintToProgramEngine (EXISTS, returns success:true unconditionally at line 1603)

units.title: WEDMDwgImportEngine — DWG file parser with LibreDWG bridge
exit_criteria: DWG R14→R2018 supported via libredwg shim
geometry extraction to same internal schema as DXF
fallback: convert to DXF via oda-file-converter when available
unit tag (mm/inch) extracted from $MEASUREMENT + $INSUNITS
integration test: 5 JM Die sample DWGs parse without error

units.title: STEPAP242PMIExtractor — Product Manufacturing Information extraction
abort_conditions: PMI not attached to geometric features
tolerances not linked to GD&T frame
exit_criteria: ISO 10303-242 entity parser covers {GEOMETRIC_TOLERANCE, DATUM_REFERENCE, DIMENSIONAL_SIZE, SURFACE_TEXTURE}
PMI linked back to geometric feature IDs
GD&T frame reconstructed with datum precedence
AtomicValue output for every tolerance {nominal, upper, lower, unit}
integration test: 3 sample STEP files extract ≥95% of PMI entities

units.title: AutoBridge wire-EDM branch + WEDM_CAPABILITY_MANIFEST
abort_conditions: WEDM not reachable from AutoBridge routing
manifest missing any of 95 WEDM engines
exit_criteria: AutoPrintToProgramBridgeEngine.route() recognizes wire-EDM capability
WEDM_CAPABILITY_MANIFEST.json enumerates all 95 WEDM engines + inputs + outputs
platform 'print → program' entry point produces WEDM G-code when process=wire_edm
integration test: AutoBridge input {process:'wire_edm', cad:'sample.dxf'} returns complete program

units.title: Multi-controller post — Mitsubishi/Sodick/Makino/Agie/Fanuc dialects
abort_conditions: any dialect fails on reference JM Die program roundtrip
exit_criteria: 5 dialects: Mitsubishi FA/MV, Sodick AQ/AL, Makino U/EU, AgieCharmilles CUT, Fanuc ROBOCUT
dialect router selects by shop profile machine inventory
each dialect emits proper E-codes (energy), C-codes (condition), M-codes (machine)
roundtrip test: parse canonical WEDM plan → emit 5 dialects → re-parse → equivalent

units.title: WEDMWirePathCollisionEngine — wire path swept-volume collision
abort_conditions: collision miss on known colliding sample
exit_criteria: swept-volume intersection for wire + upper/lower heads vs fixture + workpiece
S(x) contribution: 0 collisions → +0.15, any collision → HARD BLOCK
wedm-collision-gate hook BUILT here: blocks program emit on any collision
integration test: collision-positive sample blocks, collision-free sample passes

units.title: WEDMProgramVerificationEngine — emitted program structural verification
abort_conditions: verifier accepts program with unpaired G41/G42
exit_criteria: verifier catches: unpaired G41/G42, missing M02/M30, mismatched G20/G21 vs input, undefined E-codes, coordinate range exceeded
every WEDMPrintToProgramEngine output passes verifier or returns success:false
WEDMPrintToProgramEngine.line:1603 no longer returns unconditional success:true
wedm-program-verify hook BUILT here

units.title: consultAwareness wiring into WEDM pipeline entry
exit_criteria: every pipeline entry calls consultAwareness with {process, machine, material, wire}
awareness cache hit rate ≥80% in repeat-material test
pipeline latency regression ≤5% p95
fails-open: awareness timeout does NOT block pipeline but logs warning

hook.name: wedm-oneshot-spine-complete
hook.description: blocks merge if any of the 12 pipeline stages lacks a wired engine for WEDM

criteria: consultAwareness invoked on every pipeline entry
integration test: sample DWG → complete verified WEDM program end-to-end
